methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected from each provider's own pricing page (corroborated with 2026 pricing review sources where the official page geolocated to non-USD currency or rendered prices via a JavaScript contact slider). All figures are monthly USD at each plan's stated base contact/subscriber tier; because most providers scale price by list size, the base-tier price is recorded and the included tier is noted. Quote-only Enterprise tiers are recorded with monthlyUsd null, and minutes/calls/overage fields are null (not applicable to email marketing).

vendors.name: Mailchimp
vendors.provenance: https://mailchimp.com/pricing/marketing/ (official; geolocated to EUR, USD base prices corroborated via emailtooltester.com and costbench.com 2026 reviews)

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 250 contacts and 500 monthly sends. 1 audience, 1 seat, basic templates, single welcome automation, basic reporting.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Base price for up to 500 contacts (scales with list, max 50,000). Monthly send limit 10x contacts. 3 audiences, 3 seats, automation flows, A/B testing, SMS add-on. Price climbs with contacts (~$75/mo at 5,000).

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Base price for up to 500 contacts (scales with list, max 100,000). Monthly send limit 12x contacts. 5 audiences, 5 seats, advanced segmentation, custom templates, multivariate testing. ~$100/mo at 5,000 contacts.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Base price includes up to 10,000 contacts (max 200,000). Monthly send limit 15x contacts. Unlimited audiences, unlimited seats, phone support, extended onboarding, advanced reporting.

limits: Free: 250 contacts, 500 emails/month, 1 seat, 1 audience
Essentials: up to 50,000 contacts, 10x contacts/month send limit, 3 seats
Standard: up to 100,000 contacts, 12x contacts/month send limit, 5 seats
Premium: up to 200,000 contacts, 15x contacts/month send limit, unlimited seats
keyFeatures: Customer Journey Builder (visual automation)
Generative AI content tools
Predictive demographics and segmentation
Multivariate A/B testing (Standard+)
bestFor: Small businesses starting with email marketing
Marketers needing a wide integration ecosystem
Teams wanting an all-in-one marketing CRM + email platform
enrichment.provenance: Security page (mailchimp.com/de/about/security/) confirmed SOC 2 reports and ISO 27001 certification; GDPR confirmed via Data Processing Addendum page (EU-US Data Privacy Framework, Standard Contractual Clauses). HIPAA: the existing file records hipaa=false/baa=false and neither the security page nor DPA mentioned HIPAA or BAA — confirmed false. Free plan confirmed (250 contacts, $0). 14-day free trial confirmed on paid plans from pricing page. Direct fetch of mailchimp.com/about/security/ and several US-locale URLs returned 404 or network errors; the German-locale security page at /de/about/security/ was successfully fetched and contained the compliance content.

enrichment.provenance: GDPR confirmed via Klaviyo DPA page (Standard Contractual Clauses, EU-US Data Privacy Framework, UK GDPR). SOC 2: CORRECTED null->true. Klaviyo's official sources (Trust Center badges at trust.klaviyo.com and Klaviyo Help Center compliance section) confirm Klaviyo is SOC 2 Type II audited and ISO 27001 certified, with annual third-party audits and downloadable reports — the prior null was over-conservative (it relied only on the DPA's audit-mechanism reference). HIPAA: confirmed false. enrichment.provenance: GDPR confirmed (EU-US Data Privacy Framework certification, DPA/Standard Contractual Clauses, CCPA compliance). SOC 2: CORRECTED null->true. The official activecampaign.com/security page states ActiveCampaign is 'heavily focused on GDPR, SOC 2, and HIPAA compliance' and provides self-service access to 'our latest SOC 2 report' and penetration-test attestation via trust.activecampaign.com — confirms ActiveCampaign holds a current SOC 2 report (the prior null relied on an outdated /legal fetch). HIPAA: kept FALSE deliberately. ActiveCampaign WILL sign a BAA, but HIPAA support is gated to Enterprise customers via a manual BAA request (not published on accessible self-serve pages), the customer bears responsibility for HIPAA-compliant use, and it is not a standard platform capability — so the catalog records hipaa=false at the self-serve/platform level to avoid overstating HIPAA readiness. BAA-on-Enterprise availability noted here for completeness. No free plan; 14-day trial confirmed. Features data from activecampaign.com/features/. Note: trust.activecampaign.com is a JS-rendered trust portal not extractable via plain fetch; SOC 2 corroborated by the security page text and independent reviews.
